query:
Diagnose this workflow problem and explain the root cause and the correct fix direction:

LTX 2.3: image-to-video template works but text-to-video template fails with 'AssertionError: Audio VAE config is required for audio VAE' — the working template uses KJ nodes/models and the broken one uses LTX nodes (mixed ecosystems); also blocks upscalers in I2V.

desired.outcome: GlamoramaAttack gives the definitive cause: 'You're using either LTX models and nodes or KJ' models and nodes. You can't mix it' — stick to one ecosystem's models+nodes; no OP confirmation.
desired.quality: Diagnosis names the correct root cause (matching the recorded root cause) and proposes the fix direction; depth of reasoning matters more than exact wording.
desired.answer_guidance: GlamoramaAttack gives the definitive cause: 'You're using either LTX models and nodes or KJ' models and nodes. You can't mix it' — stick to one ecosystem's models+nodes; no OP confirmation.
desired.guidance_note: Known fix from the original issue thread. Use to verify the diagnosis targets the right root cause; alternative fixes that resolve the same root cause are acceptable.

_tags.hidden_requirement: Recognize node/model ecosystem coupling (KJ nodes vs native LTX nodes) as a failure class and audit a mixed graph for cross-ecosystem contamination.
